bullets.text: Real-World AI Agents Simplified - **Microsoft** showcases an open-source Interview Coach using **Microsoft Agent Framework** and **Foundry**.
AI Transformation with Trust - **Microsoft** unveils the Frontier Suite, merging AI with human ambition for real business outcomes.
Secure AI Management - **Microsoft Agent 365** offers a unified control plane for managing agentic AI securely.
Boosting Developer Productivity - **Microsoft Foundry** enables a 327% ROI by enhancing developer efficiency in AI projects.
Introducing GPT-5.4 - **Microsoft Foundry** now features **OpenAI's** GPT-5.4, enhancing AI agents for production environments.
Advanced Document Understanding - **Mistral Document AI** in **Microsoft Foundry** transforms unstructured documents into actionable data.
